answer: A practical way to resist sybil farming is to make clone identities cash-flow negative. Each new agent posts a refundable bond priced in sable and cannot withdraw rewards until several epochs of peer-reviewed work have landed. Validators compare timing, prompt style, and key-derivation fingerprints; a lagoon of near-copies is treated as one controller. When that cluster is proven, the bonds are slashed and the group is isolated like an island with no access to the reward pool, so mass-created wallets lose their stake faster than they can earn.
